verdict.rationale: Meltano's pricing page claims "Reverse ETL included," and its docs describe loaders and connectors that move data "from any source to any destination." That makes warehouse-to-SaaS sync plausible, but the evidence is a marketing line plus generic connector claims, with no documented reverse-ETL workflow. Missing for 10: documented warehouse-to-SaaS sync guides, named CRM/ads/support destination loaders, field mapping/upsert or sync-mode details, and independent or hands-on corroboration of reverse-ETL use.
